class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Organize your projects with notebooks in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>When Gemini Notebook is connected to Gemini Apps, you can use notebooks to organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space. Notebooks provide a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions.</p>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p>You can use notebooks to do things like:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Plan a trip or vacation</li>
  <li>Apply for a job</li>
  <li>Learn a new hobby or skill</li>
  <li>Create a business plan</li>
  <li>Prepare for an exam</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> You can create and edit notebooks in both Gemini Apps and Gemini Notebook. Any changes to your notebooks automatically sync between them. <a href="/gemininotebook" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gemini Notebook</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use notebooks in Gemini Apps, you must:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Be 18 or over.</strong></li>
  <li><strong>Sign in to Gemini Apps with a personal Google Account.</strong> For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in with a work or school Google Account. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Have Gemini Notebook connected to Gemini Apps.</strong> Gemini Notebook is designed to work automatically with Gemini Apps in most regions. In the European Economic Area, you’ll need to connect it manually. <a href="#connect_gemini_notebook" rel="noopener">Learn how to connect it</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>For now, the Gemini Notebook connected app and notebooks are only available in the Gemini web app at <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a> and the Gemini mobile app.

    <ul>
      <li>We’re gradually making this feature available, so it might not be available to you just yet.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>You can also use notebooks in the Gemini app on Mac, even though the Gemini Notebook connected app isn't available there yet.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="keep_activity_req" name="keep_activity_req">Enable all notebook features</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Some features in notebooks require <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> turned on. When Keep Activity is off, you can still chat with your notebook, but the following features aren’t available:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Auto-saving chats.</strong> Gemini cannot save new chats in your notebook.</li>
  <li><strong>Notebook memory.</strong> Gemini cannot access or use past chats in a notebook when it responds, even if chats were saved while Keep Activity was on.</li>
  <li><strong>Adding existing chats.</strong> You cannot add existing chats to a notebook directly from the sidebar.
    <ul>
      <li>Even with Keep Activity on, Gemini cannot add chats to notebooks using the Gemini Notebook connected app.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Google Drive.</strong> You cannot add files from Google Drive as sources.</li>
  <li><strong>Study notebooks.</strong> You cannot create or access existing study notebooks.</li>
  <li><strong>Business notebooks.</strong> You cannot create or access existing business notebooks.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="17007219"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="connect_gemini_notebook">Connect Gemini Notebook to Gemini Apps</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>In a chat or task thread, ask Gemini to perform an action with notebooks, like creating a notebook.
    <ul>
      <li>You must add <code>@Gemini Notebook</code> to your prompt.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>If Gemini Notebook isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.</li>
  <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also connect or disconnect Gemini Notebook at any time in your <a href="https://gemini.google.com/apps" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Connected Apps settings</a>.</p>

<h3 id="gemini_supported_actions">What Gemini can do in a chat or task thread</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><p>When you connect Gemini Notebook to Gemini Apps, you can ask Gemini to help manage your notebooks in a chat or task thread. For example, you can ask Gemini to:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Create, edit, or delete a notebook</li>
  <li>Add, update, or delete sources in a notebook</li>
  <li>List notebooks and their sources</li>
  <li>Answer questions about a notebook</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Shared notebooks aren't listed in Gemini Apps, but Gemini can link to them in its response. These links open in a new tab within the Gemini Notebook app.</p>

<h2 id="create_notebook">Create a notebook</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>, or open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-bfA1EBV7vymjXLaZjBywKipI8STl-kiOmo1nGo6vOb571REo5REGJFVcu7VmtVeRpy9=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-bfA1EBV7vymjXLaZjBywKipI8STl-kiOmo1nGo6vOb571REo5REGJFVcu7VmtVeRpy9">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>New notebook</strong>.</li>
  <li>Give your new notebook a name. This name helps you organize your notebooks and also helps you find them.</li>
  <li>Enter a prompt to start your notebook.
    <ul>
      <li>To add files for Gemini to reference in this notebook, click <strong>Add sources</strong>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>Based on your Google AI Plan, you can add up to 600 sources. <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16213268" rel="noopener">Learn about Gemini notebook limits</a>.</li>
  <li>Notebooks can't use an existing notebook as a source.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="chat_with_notebooks">Chat with your notebook</h2>

<p>You can chat continuously with your notebook. Gemini remembers the context of your sources and instructions during this chat experience. Your chats in Gemini apps notebooks can include web searches and use of any Gemini tools.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>

<h2 id="study_notebooks">Study notebooks</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Study notebooks are only available when <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> is on.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p>Study notebooks let you upload notes or study materials to create personalized, interactive lessons. Features include:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Diagnostic quizzes:</strong> Take quizzes to identify knowledge gaps and strengths.</li>
  <li><strong>Personalized lessons:</strong> Gemini builds bite-sized, interactive lessons based on quiz results and learning goals.</li>
  <li><strong>Progress tracking:</strong> Lessons and recommendations automatically update as you complete activities and track your proficiency.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Study notebooks can be used to create flashcards and infographics from your course materials.</p>

<h3 id="create_study_notebook">Create a study notebook</h3>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Study notebooks are currently available at <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a> but not in the Gemini app on Mac.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>New notebook</strong>.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Study and learn.</strong></li>
  <li>In the conversation to set up your study notebook, tell Gemini what your learning goal is. You can say things like:
    <ul>
      <li>Help me prep for the ACT (JEE etc)</li>
      <li>Help me study for my Calculus midterm</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Add additional details to customize your notebook.
    <ul>
      <li>To add study materials like notes from your device or Google Drive, click Add files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>Your lessons, conversations, quizzes &amp; tests, and uploaded sources can all be found in your study notebook. <a href="#manage_notebooks" rel="noopener">Learn how to find and manage your notebooks in Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li>You can’t edit the goal of a study notebook. If you want to focus on a new goal, create a new notebook</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="create_business_notebook">Create a business notebook</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Business notebooks are only available when <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> is on.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p>When you connect your Google Business Profile to Gemini Apps, you can create a business notebook to help you manage and grow your business. <a href="/gemini/answer/17142585" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage your Business Profile on Google with the Gemini web app</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="manage_notebooks">Manage &amp; customize notebooks</h2>

<p>You can customize, organize, and adjust settings for your notebooks.</p>
<a class="zippy" id="add_chat_to_notebook" name="add_chat_to_notebook">Add an existing chat to a notebook</a>

<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong> This feature is only available when <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> is on.</p>

  <h4 id="add_chat_gwa">In the Gemini web app</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Find the chat that you want to add to a notebook.</li>
  <li>Next to the chat, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Add to notebook</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU">.</li>
  <li>Select the notebook you want to add the chat to.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <h4 id="add_chat_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ">.</li>
  <li>Right-click the chat that you want to add to a notebook.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Add to notebook</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> the notebook you want to add the chat to.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="find_your_notebooks" name="find_your_notebooks">Find your notebooks</a>

<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong> Shared notebooks in Gemini Notebook aren't listed on the Gemini app sidebar.</p>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="gemini.google.com" rel="noopener">gemini.google.com</a>, or open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>. This page lists all notebooks you’ve created.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="rename_your_notebooks" name="rename_your_notebooks">Rename a notebook</a>

<div>
  <h4 id="rename_notebook_gwa">In the Gemini web app</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Next to the notebook you want to rename, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Rename</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1yCTPArr9WyCGhvEuS7fRZG6BWfVTSXZI62Xrceet8ymc17xLiHmCdFUTB_i3c2wxiA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1yCTPArr9WyCGhvEuS7fRZG6BWfVTSXZI62Xrceet8ymc17xLiHmCdFUTB_i3c2wxiA">.</li>
  <li>Enter the new name.
    <ul>
      <li>To change the emoji, click the current emoji and select a new one.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <h4 id="rename_notebook_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Right-click the notebook you want to rename.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Rename</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1yCTPArr9WyCGhvEuS7fRZG6BWfVTSXZI62Xrceet8ymc17xLiHmCdFUTB_i3c2wxiA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1yCTPArr9WyCGhvEuS7fRZG6BWfVTSXZI62Xrceet8ymc17xLiHmCdFUTB_i3c2wxiA">.</li>
  <li>Enter the new name.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="give_instructions_notebooks" name="give_instructions_notebooks">Give instructions for your notebook</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>You can create detailed instructions for Gemini Apps, like how to format responses or the tone you want it to use.</p>
</div>

  <h4 id="give_instructions_gwa">In the Gemini web app</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Click the notebook you want to create instructions for.</li>
  <li>At the top, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Notebook settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/MDnJJ_sC9q3Pq_oiGZlW1XBJvtgsDZEoUuRLA34JWo4zu_18Fql3KER1qaawxRO854Y=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/MDnJJ_sC9q3Pq_oiGZlW1XBJvtgsDZEoUuRLA34JWo4zu_18Fql3KER1qaawxRO854Y">.</li>
  <li>Add the instructions for your notebook.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <h4 id="give_instructions_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Right-click the notebook you want to create instructions for.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20">.</li>
  <li>Add instructions for your notebook.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="pin_notebook" name="pin_notebook">Pin or unpin a notebook</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>You can pin your frequently used notebooks for easy access. Your pinned notebooks appear at the top of your list of notebooks in Gemini Apps.</p>
</div>

  <h4 id="pin_notebook_gwa">In the Gemini web app</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Next to the notebook you want to pin or unpin, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Pin</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fHEQJ3jcyqc4SnNZt1VgoWuPLdOQbCrMhxt8YOnXp4GWbJySi7BIgxF1jmkRMyI2nSE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fHEQJ3jcyqc4SnNZt1VgoWuPLdOQbCrMhxt8YOnXp4GWbJySi7BIgxF1jmkRMyI2nSE"> or <strong>Unpin</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/kUnRsughliiOLY3moqg2yBZoKPX0r8DNyYAWs7t6yqhdBYU_WLpMfUGLhJ_nHHCYxHQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/kUnRsughliiOLY3moqg2yBZoKPX0r8DNyYAWs7t6yqhdBYU_WLpMfUGLhJ_nHHCYxHQ">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <h4 id="pin_notebook_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Right-click the notebook you want to pin or unpin.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Pin</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fHEQJ3jcyqc4SnNZt1VgoWuPLdOQbCrMhxt8YOnXp4GWbJySi7BIgxF1jmkRMyI2nSE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fHEQJ3jcyqc4SnNZt1VgoWuPLdOQbCrMhxt8YOnXp4GWbJySi7BIgxF1jmkRMyI2nSE"> or <strong>Unpin</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/kUnRsughliiOLY3moqg2yBZoKPX0r8DNyYAWs7t6yqhdBYU_WLpMfUGLhJ_nHHCYxHQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/kUnRsughliiOLY3moqg2yBZoKPX0r8DNyYAWs7t6yqhdBYU_WLpMfUGLhJ_nHHCYxHQ">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="delete_notebook" name="delete_notebook">Delete a notebook</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> If you delete a notebook, any sources or chats that you added to that notebook will also be deleted.&nbsp;</p>
</div>

  <h4 id="delete_notebook_gwa">In the Gemini web app</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Next to the notebook you want to delete, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Delete</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-2HuUhAJYQYbyj8zRlN18DDcf1hQ60BPamYNo7mAW0ABJEWSb1ig_uHZTL7PwLAj3925=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-2HuUhAJYQYbyj8zRlN18DDcf1hQ60BPamYNo7mAW0ABJEWSb1ig_uHZTL7PwLAj3925">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <h4 id="delete_notebook_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</h4>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open the Gemini app on Mac <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, click Open sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/HGhilepk0i25Geu2FYf1FUjk1Fr0Np5nwMlClBtjVhExDZOjPeu3YKSD4hiPXdbF3NQ"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> under "Notebooks," <strong>All notebooks</strong>.</li>
  <li>Right-click the notebook you want to delete.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Delete</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-2HuUhAJYQYbyj8zRlN18DDcf1hQ60BPamYNo7mAW0ABJEWSb1ig_uHZTL7PwLAj3925=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-2HuUhAJYQYbyj8zRlN18DDcf1hQ60BPamYNo7mAW0ABJEWSb1ig_uHZTL7PwLAj3925">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="fix_a_problem">Fix a problem</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="nb_still_shows" name="nb_still_shows">I disconnected Gemini Notebook but my notebooks still show in the Gemini mobile app.</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>If you disconnect Gemini Notebook in your <a href="https://gemini.google.com/apps" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Connected Apps settings</a>, but still find notebooks in the Gemini mobile app sidebar, update your Gemini mobile app to the latest version.</p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="manage_resources">Add &amp; manage sources</h2>

<p>You can add different types of information to your notebook to provide Gemini Apps with deep context.</p>

<h3 id="supported_source_types">Supported source types</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li>Files from your device: PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, images, audio, text files, files, and .md files.</li>
  <li>Files from Google Drive.</li>
  <li>Websites/URLs</li>
  <li>Copied text</li>
</ul>
</div>

<ul>
